simulated_from_backtest_trades.method: 5-trade block bootstrap of the 612 backtest trades, 20k reps; 'no edge' = same trades de-meaned

expected_duration: about 22 months at the out-of-sample rate of 6.9 trades/month
backtest_basis: C001 '+r1_pdh_break' variant, selected post-hoc (1 of 5 filter variants) in the 2026-10-16 backtest: all-days PF 1.42 points (IS 1.41 / OOS 1.44), modelled 1-lot ATM CE +Rs 141,963 over 612 trades, 10 real-price trades +Rs 5,050.
